title: Introduction to Databases
description: This module covers modern database system structures, relational database modelling, normalisation, SQL query design, and contemporary database technologies. Students understand the separation of physical and logical models and transaction management.
learning_objectives: Compare and contrast different database models and supporting architectures
Model information in a relational system
Optimise a relational schema and demonstrate correctness of optimisations
Design relational queries and write SQL queries
Set up a database, implement a schema as well as the queries
Explain the benefits of separating physical and logical models
topics: Functional dependencies, keys and normal forms
